name: CWC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top title, contested through a sixteen-man single-elimination tournament announced at its own founding and scheduled to conclude at its own first pay-per-view, First Night; vacant when the held record ends, with the tournament having reached its semifinals (Havoc, "Blockbuster" Johnny Detson, Crimestarter Jim and Leviathan).

name: CWC International People's Championship
epitaph: A second singles title the fed's own president announced by name and bracket (26 May 1998), with its own tournament scheduled to run entirely at First Night; vacant and uncontested when the held record ends.

name: CWC North American Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created for a four-way elimination match at the fed's own first pay-per-view, Prime Time in North America (21 July 1998); Paul Kingstead became its first champion and still held it when the held record ends.

name: CWC World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Contested through a tag team tournament run across the fed's own final weeks; the L.A. Wrecking Crew beat the Hardcore Icons for the vacant belts at Prime Time in North America (21 July 1998) and still held them when the held record ends.
